title: GLM loop schedule — independent of Claude's cloud jobs
note_schema: Same structure as loop-engine-state/schedule.json (root), with two deltas on the glm/ branch: the agent enum is extended with "glm", and prompt paths live under glm/prompts/. Validated by glm/schemas/glm-schedule.schema.json. Root schedule.json is never touched.

blackout_windows_tunis.reason: Claude cloud-dispatch fires 01:45 and runs due night jobs (maintenance, improvements, kinz-accounting, creative, analyst) for up to ~60 min.
Claude cloud-dispatch fires 06:45 and runs morning jobs (daily-commit, weekly-summary).

conflict_guard.rule: Before any PR-writing loop: if any claude/* or loop/claude/* branch in any allowlisted repo was pushed within the last 2 hours, do read-only work only this session. Per repo: if the repo has an open PR whose head branch starts with claude/, skip that repo.

loops.name: glm-improvement-am
loops.title: GLM loop: morning improvement
loops.purpose: Morning improvement pass: take the top GLM-suitable backlog item(s), ship 1-2 small well-tested PRs, squash-merge when CI is green. Caps: max 2 PRs per session, max 1 per repo, zero open GLM PRs at session end.

loops.name: glm-improvement-pm
loops.title: GLM loop: afternoon improvement
loops.purpose: Second improvement slot on Tue/Thu/Sat, deliberately offset from Claude's improvements job (Mon/Wed/Fri 01:45). Same caps and contract as the morning loop; prefer repos Claude's rotation cursor is far from reaching.

loops.name: glm-analyst-scan
loops.title: GLM loop: read-only analyst
loops.purpose: Read-only daily scan, zero PRs anywhere: are all 8 mains green, any new open PRs, does each repo still have >= 3 GLM-suitable backlog items, any new code signals worth queueing. Writes findings to glm/findings/ and candidate items to glm/backlog.json only. Safe to run even during Claude activity.

loops.name: glm-backlog-refresh
loops.title: GLM loop: weekly backlog regeneration
loops.purpose: Sunday deep scan: full regeneration of glm/backlog.json from repo docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md files, TODO/except sweeps, coverage-gap heuristics and fresh code reading. Removes done/stale items, re-scores, and records large or owner-blocked findings in glm/findings/ instead of the queue.

loops.name: glm-state-hygiene
loops.title: GLM loop: weekly state hygiene
loops.purpose: Saturday reconciliation: compare glm/state.json PR ledger against GitHub truth, delete GLM's own already-merged glm/* branches (best-effort, never force), verify zero open glm PRs, repair any drift between state, backlog and reality.
